newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nomura's underwriting business falls sharply - paper.
newsitem.headline: Nomura's underwriting business falls sharply - paper.

text.p: Nomura Securities Co Ltd has lost market share in underwriting straight bonds due to a recent scandal involving suspected illegal deals, a Japanese business daily reported on Tuesday.
Since the beginning of April, Nomura has underwritten 16 billion yen worth of straight bonds, or 2.5 percent of the total issued so far in the month, the Nihon Keizai Shimbun said.
This compares with a 14 percent market share Japan's largest brokerage had for underwriting straight bonds in the fiscal year which ended on March 31.
A company spokesman was not immediately available to comment on the report.

On March 6, Nomura announced that an internal probe had found that two of its directors had been involved in apparently illegal deals which involved transferring money from a Nomura account to a corporate client's account.
